authoritative_crash_evidence.exception_reason: The .ips reports contain no more specific exception reason than abort() called.

authoritative_release_evidence.lifecycle_conclusion: Both crashing Build 16 and Build 17 binaries were compiled after Flutter 3.47.2 performed its build-working-tree UIScene migration. Build 18 source-controls the equivalent post-migration lifecycle to remove build-time mutation. This does not identify the crash root cause.
